product_overview: The Collegiate Academic Portal is a campus services app for TSU students, faculty, and staff to manage day-to-day needs across shuttle travel, canteen ordering, document printing, and merchandise pre-orders. It provides a unified dashboard for navigating between campus utilities within the TSU Main and Lucinda campus ecosystem.
core_goals: Help users quickly access campus services from a single dashboard
Let users book shuttle passes between TSU Main Campus and Lucinda Campus
Let users pre-order canteen food and track order progress
Let users submit documents for printing and receive a pickup PIN
Let users browse, favorite, and purchase student organization merchandise

features.name: Campus Hub Dashboard
features.description: Provides a central landing page where users switch between campuses and view active service trackers for shuttle and canteen activity.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Toggle the active campus -> View the available active trackers
Navigate to / -> Switch between campus contexts -> Observe updated service shortcuts and tracker status

features.name: Campus Shuttle Booking
features.description: Lets users choose a travel direction, select a seat, and generate a shuttle boarding pass for the TSU Main and Lucinda corridor.
user_flows: Navigate to /shuttle -> Select the travel direction -> Select an available seat -> Book the shuttle pass -> See the boarding pass ticket
Navigate to /shuttle -> Select the opposite campus route -> Select a different seat -> Book the shuttle pass -> See the updated ticket details

features.name: Canteen Express Food Ordering
features.description: Lets users browse canteen menu categories, add or remove items from a cart, and place an order for pickup tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /canteen -> Filter food categories -> Add items to the cart -> Review the cart -> Checkout -> See the live order tracker
Navigate to /canteen -> Filter food categories -> Add an item -> Remove an item using the quantity control -> Review the cart -> Checkout -> See the order status pipeline

features.name: Print Hub Document Processing
features.description: Lets users choose a print shop, configure print job settings, and submit documents to generate a print PIN for pickup.
user_flows: Navigate to /print -> Select a print shop -> Configure page count and print options -> Submit the document -> See the generated Print PIN
Navigate to /print -> Select a print shop -> Change print settings -> Submit the document -> See confirmation with pickup details

features.name: Merch Catalog Shopping
features.description: Lets users browse organization merchandise, save favorites, choose sizes, add items to a cart, and complete checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /merch -> Filter products by organization -> Mark a product as a favorite -> Select a size -> Add the item to the cart -> View the cart -> Checkout
Navigate to /merch -> Filter products by organization -> Select a product size -> Add items to the cart -> Open the sliding cart view -> Review the order -> Checkout
